chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 482: Subhuti Annihilates the Mother Queens & the Broken Horn World
chapter_meta_description: Patriarch Subhuti speaks two words and kills three Daofather-level avatars, then reaches across the void to obliterate an entire world in this epic chapter of Desolate Era.
og_title: The Most Powerful Rescue in Xianxia: Two Words, Three Dead Gods
og_description: Patriarch Subhuti proves why he is the most mysterious Daofather of the Three Realms by casually wiping out the Mother Queens and their entire world.
twitter_description: A single palm, half a world, zero survivors. Subhuti delivers the ultimate rescue in this chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: In Daoist mythology and *Journey to the West*, Subhuti is the secretive master of Sun Wukong. In *Desolate Era*, he is a Primordial True God and Ji Ning’s master, wielding the supreme Dao of Spacetime.
The collective title for the supreme rulers of the Broken Horn World. These ancient, bloated beings survived the primordial war and commanded Daofather-threshold power.
A world on the edge of the ancient ruins, inhabited by the Horned clan. It is governed by the three Mother Queens and a Hall of Elders.
The dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the Chaosverse. It has no Dao resonance, making it a hostile environment where cultivators rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce.
The combined divine form of seven Empyrean Gods, former retainers of Daoist Threelives. They barely scratch the threshold of Daofather-level power.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Patriarch Subhuti kill the three Mother Queen avatars so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Subhuti is a peak Daofather who has fully mastered the Heavenly Dao of Spacetime. The three avatars were only at the threshold of Daofather power, making them utterly insignificant in comparison.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Subhuti destroy the entire Broken Horn World?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It was a dual purpose: to rescue his disciple and to send a political statement to any remaining ancient powers that harming a Dao-father’s disciple invites absolute annihilation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What did Ji Ning gain from his eighteen years in the Realm of Annihilation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He tempered his Heartforce to the Dominion level, learned to channel Heartforce through his sword-fingers, and grasped a trace of Sword Force. These are massive breakthroughs for his cultivation path.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why could Subhuti teleport through the Realm of Annihilation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Realm of Annihilation is normally impassable via spatial travel due to its lack of Dao resonance. Subhuti, as the supreme master of Spacetime, can override this limitation.
